title: Why you should ditch spreadsheets for Tables
summary: Ready to make your spreadsheet more actionable? See why you should switch to tables instead.
body_markdown: **Did you know?** Zapier actions used in Tables[don't count toward Zapier's task usage limit](https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/19695684535309-Understand-the-price-changes-to-Zapier-Tables#h_01HAVQ9P8QM89CDFG29Z4MFD6G) . They don't affect your overall Zapier task quota, allowing you to automate more processes without worrying about exceeding your plan's limits.
